text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin wins first place at the<n>Arima Kinen, and
her family and<n>friends celebrate like there's no
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But it's not just Ines's fans who are<n>moved by
the sight of her chasing her<n>dreams. Oguri
Cap—who was rumored<n>to be retiring—is also
inspired to hope<n>again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines's running isn't a selfish act at<n>all—it's the
very embodiment of<n>everyone's dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that it's okay for her to run<n>as much as
she wants, and to enjoy<n>it too, Ines wells up. It's
not long<n>before her cheeks are glistening with<n>warm
tears.
